policy: Any party that discharges dredged or fill material into waters of the United States must obtain a Section 404 permit, except that normal farming, silviculture, and ranching activities that are part of an established, ongoing operation are exempt from the permit requirement.
scenario: Sandhill Farm, an established and continuously operated cattle ranch, plows a field crossing a small jurisdictional wetland as part of its routine annual planting that it has performed every season for fifteen years. The plowing incidentally redeposits soil within the wetland.
question: Must Sandhill Farm obtain a Section 404 permit for this plowing?
